name: Musician
description: Support caster focused on inspiring allies and controlling the battlefield through songs and music.

name: Disciple
description: Divine servant channeling the power of their god for protection, healing, and smiting the unholy.

name: Wildborn
description: Nature-attuned warrior drawing power from the natural world through shapeshifting, storms, and druidic magic.

name: Warrior
description: Martial combatant excelling in physical combat through rage, defensive mastery, or tactical prowess.

name: Monk
description: Unarmed combatant channeling inner energy through martial arts, self-sacrifice, or sacred healing touch.

name: Archer
description: Ranged specialist mastering precision shots, magical arrows, or beast companion tactics.

name: Rogue
description: Stealth-focused operative specializing in assassination, thievery, or shadow magic.

name: Corruptor
description: Dark caster wielding spirits, undead, or demonic pacts to corrupt and control.

name: Wizard
description: Arcane scholar mastering raw sorcery, mental manipulation, or elemental destruction.

name: Battlemage
description: Armored spellcaster blending martial combat with magic for frontline spellcasting.

name: Wraith Hunter
description: Supernatural hunter specializing in tracking and destroying otherworldly threats through runes, curses, or phantom powers.
